_comment: One record per product (DEPLOYMENT-AND-STOREFRONT-PLAN 2026-10-24 §4.1). Each product has a public page at app.lwliann.com/<id> rendered by src/product.js. A platform row may carry a web url (Open), a store (badge; storeUrl empty = coming) and a downloads slot (file from data/downloads.json, offered only with bytes and sha256). Copy is read from the shipped apps; no superlatives, no comparisons.

products.name: PolyFlow
products.oneLine: Multilingual lyrics that turn the page as you play.
products.audience: Musicians, worship teams and learners through music.
points: A song's words in several languages on one line: characters, pronunciation and translation.
Rehearse a line once and PolyFlow remembers how many notes it took; next time, Auto turns the page for you.
Three editions on one player: Studio (full local workspace, no sign-in), Performance (connected workspace, AlongSide sign-in) and Light (simpler stage workspace, no sign-in).
Background visuals, a built-in piano with five voices, takes you can play back and score, and word study saved to AlongSide.

platforms.note: Chrome or Edge for Export video; everything else works in any current browser.
Android 7.0 or newer with Chrome. The APK opens the same editions as the web app.
Preview installer, not yet code-signed: Windows may ask you to confirm the publisher.

products.name: LiANN Pinyin Tiles
products.oneLine: Build the word. Hear the tones. Know what it means.
products.audience: Anyone learning Mandarin words and tones, from the first lesson.
points: Place Pinyin initials and finals to build words, then choose the tone for every syllable.
Every scored word shows its verified English meaning; recorded pronunciations let you hear the tones.
Play a solo match against one computer opponent; Novice mode protects your rack while you learn.
No account needed. My words and Stats stay on your device, and an optional LiANN sign-in sends your words to AlongSide SetLists.

platforms.note: In internal testing on Google Play.

products.name: LiANN Pinyin Puzzle
products.oneLine: Read the clue. Build the Pinyin. Cross every answer.
products.audience: Learners who like a crossword, from HSK 1 to 3.
points: An 11 by 11 crossword where each square holds one Pinyin initial or final, and the finals carry the tone.
English meanings are the clues; shared squares mean every answer you solve helps solve the next.
Three puzzles a day on a 365-day cycle. Nothing is timed.
Your score and placed tiles are saved on your device.

platforms.note: An Android build of the crossword is on its way.

products.name: LiANN Pinyin Mahjong Tones
products.oneLine: Find matching words and meanings. Hear each word. Choose its tones to clear the board.
products.audience: Learners from HSK 1 to 3 who want tone practice that feels like a game.
points: Match a word tile to its English meaning, hear the word, then give it the right tones.
Practice, Challenge and Zen modes; boards from 16 to 72 tiles; HSK 1, 2 and 3 word sets, tone pairs and a daily board.
Hint, Undo and Shuffle when you need them; a seed for every board so a round can be replayed.
Playing never needs an account. Sign in only to sync saved words with AlongSide.

platforms.note: The Unity edition for Windows is being prepared for the Microsoft Store.

products.name: AlongSide
products.kind: App · web, with Android, iPhone and iPad to come
products.oneLine: Your words, your reviews and your tutor's classroom in one place.
products.audience: Students and tutors of Learning with LiANN.
points: Students curate vocabulary into SetLists, build recall through Word Mastery and follow HSK Milestones.
Tutors craft curricula in AuthorBoard, teach through MultiBoard and ClassRoom, and review learner SetLists.
Words saved from the Pinyin games and from PolyFlow arrive in the same SetLists.
Saving your own words is free; plans are for households, tutors and organisations that share.

platforms.note: A test build for Android testers; the Google Play listing follows.

products.name: Dual Subs
products.kind: YouTube app · Chrome and Edge on desktop
products.oneLine: Multiple subtitled languages at once on YouTube.
products.audience: Learners who watch YouTube in the language they are learning.
points: Show more than one subtitle language at the same time on any YouTube video.
Save the words you meet and review them with spaced repetition.
Export saved words and SetLists to AlongSide.
Preview build for testers: unzip, open chrome://extensions, turn on Developer mode and choose Load unpacked.

platforms.note: The public release will come from the Chrome Web Store.

products.name: LyricSync
products.kind: YouTube app · Chrome and Edge on desktop
products.oneLine: Turn any song into a multilingual master.
products.audience: Singers, worship teams and learners who work from song lyrics.
points: Capture a song's lyrics from YouTube and build a master with language layers.
On-device OCR reads lyrics from the video when captions are missing.
Open a master in PolyFlow to rehearse and perform it.
Preview build for testers: unzip, open chrome://extensions, turn on Developer mode and choose Load unpacked.

platforms.note: The public release will come from the Chrome Web Store.

products.name: LiANN HUB
products.oneLine: Your Learning with LiANN apps, games, Library and downloads in one place.
points: Home, Apps, Library, Read, Figures, Discover, Kids, Shop, Downloads and Plan in one hub.
Sign in with a six-digit code sent to your email; there is no password.
Open your AlongSide SetLists in the Library after signing in.
The Windows and Mac apps open the same hub in their own window; external app links open in your browser.

platforms.note: Windows installer. The preview build is unsigned; Windows may ask you to confirm the publisher.
